Synopsis:
Vlaaktih appears as a hologram and Laezel meets her for the first time. Avatar can decide if she accepts her orders to kill the prisoner or refuse. In both cases, the planecaster is activated.If you refuse, Vlaakith orders the inquisitor if alive to kill you if you try to exit the room or theatens to hunt you down if he's already dead. If Laezel is not yet convinced to side with the player, they have a chance to do it here if they refuse.

context: The scene opens with Vlaakith manifesting as a massive hologram from the planecaster after the Astral Prism / Orpheus artefact is found; Lae'zel is meeting Vlaakith for the first time and the inquisitor and his retinue are present and deferential. Vlaakith claims a corrupted prisoner is trapped inside the Prism — an agent of the Grand Design who must be killed to protect the gith — and offers Lae'zel “ascension” if she carries out the deed. The player, who is holding or returning the artefact, can either obey or refuse; in either case Vlaakith activates the planecaster so the artefact can be opened (and the Astral Prison accessed). If the player refuses, Vlaakith orders the inquisitor (if still alive) to kill the player should they try to leave, or vows to hunt them if the inquisitor is already dead, and Lae'zel may be persuaded here to side with the player depending on prior rapport.
